articles.title: Elon Musk says SpaceX raised $40 billion in debt for GPUs
articles.description: Musk's post comes after Reuters reported earlier this month that SpaceX is in talks with banks and asset managers to raise $40 billion for the purchase of Nvidia artificial intelligence chips.

articles.title: Banks pass on rate hikes, but go slow when rates fall; RBI study finds
articles.description: A recent study by the RBI indicates that banks are more responsive to interest rate hikes than to cuts. Specifically, banks relayed 76.4% of repo rate increases, while only 64% of reductions were passed on. Amid periods of tightening, lending rates surged significantly, in contrast to the minimal decreases observed during easing. This research highlights the intricate dynamics of interest rate adjustments, particularly affecting sectors like MSMEs.

articles.title: Next airport privatisation will be different
articles.description: Airport privatisation: Centre prepares to offer eleven regional airports in five fixed bundles for fifty years, shifting focus from metropolitan trophy assets to regional growth and investment challenges across the country.

articles.title: Oil Price Today (October 26): Crude oil at $115, retreats from 6-month high despite lingering concerns. What are experts saying?
articles.description: US crude futures declined $1.82, or 2%, to $101.48 a barrel, while Brent crude futures dropped $1.50, or 1.72%, to $115 a barrel. Both benchmarks had settled nearly $3 higher on Friday following Houthi attacks in Saudi Arabia that heightened concerns over energy supplies. Brent gained 6% over the week, while US West Texas Intermediate (WTI) rose 2.3%.

articles.title: The heavy price of India’s commute
articles.description: National Statistics Office surveys reveal public transport is failing Indian commuters as private vehicle use surges. Data highlights heavy monthly travel costs, dominant two-wheeler use, and major domestic tourism trends.

articles.title: EPFO considers Rs 25,000cr war chest to stabilise interest payouts
articles.description: Employees’ Provident Fund Organisation is exploring the establishment of a Rs 25,000-crore Interest Stabilisation Reserve. This reserve aims to protect members’ interest payouts from corporate bond defaults and other market fluctuations. A report suggested that the fund should be built via surplus ETF gains and will invest in government securities. Historical performance indicates that this reserve can effectively manage interest rate stability.

articles.title: Crude oil is the key to bringing FII money back to Dalal Street: Equirus AMC’s Ashutosh Tiwari
articles.description: Foreign investors may return to Indian equities only if crude oil prices cool, according to Ashutosh Tiwari, managing director and chief investment officer—public equities at Equirus Asset Management. While valuations have corrected and earnings growth is expected to improve, rising oil prices have emerged as the key trigger behind renewed FII selling and remain the biggest hurdle to a sharper market re-rating.

articles.title: Gold lingers near three-month low ahead of Fed policy meeting
articles.description: Gold prices dipped close to a three-month low, reflecting worries from investors as the Federal Reserve meeting approaches. While an interest rate hike appears more likely for December, this week’s chances remain low. In the oil market, prices fell back after a prior rise, amid ongoing supply worries linked to conflicts.

articles.title: How a Fake Amazon Phone Call Cost a Retired Nurse $400K, and What You Can Do to Protect Your Parents
articles.description: Americans 60 and older lost more than $7.7 billion to scams last year, and AI is making the cons harder to spot. I spoke to cybersecurity experts to find out how the scammers think.

articles.title: Competition Commission of India to hire 41 across departments
articles.description: Individuals will be hired for positions at both CCI and its investigation arm, the director general (DG) office, according to public notices.

articles.title: Telangana | People pre-book rice harvest to lock prices; farmers get ₹3,000-₹3,500 per quintal in open markets
articles.description: Farmers in Telangana command higher prices, selling rice in open market for ₹3,000–₹3,500 per quintal while pre-booking buyers lock prices ahead.

articles.title: Insurance commission: NBFCs seek 5-year transition period to reduce selling fee
articles.description: The industry body of NBFCs has told the Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India (IRDAI) that the proposed commission caps of 2% for credit life and 5% for credit health insurance would make credit-linked insurance distribution unviable, given distribution costs are about 32% of the premium.

articles.title: In 1834, a historic Métis family home was built beside Georgian Bay in Canada; 192 years later, its owner transferred it for just $2 and the 75,000-pound house was moved across the water for a planned museum
articles.description: The historic Labatte House, a Métis residence from 1834, is set to be carefully moved to Balm Beach to ensure its preservation. Weighing approximately 75,000 pounds, the relocation is a meticulous endeavor across Georgian Bay. This effort seeks to create a museum dedicated to Indigenous and Métis narratives in the area, with restoration scheduled to start soon and a concrete foundation expected by spring 2027.

articles.title: IIT Bhubaneswar gets 120 entries for Design for Bharat 2027 challenge
articles.description: IIT Bhubaneswar received 120 Odisha applications for Design for Bharat 2027; 12 solutions submitted so far. Open Challenge entries open till Oct 31.

articles.description: Bengal, with Centre’s support, plans a 3-phase project to redirect the Ganga in Malda, build nine spurs, dredge a new channel and reduce flood risk.

articles.title: Revanth to meet Fadnavis for Tummidihatti project height approval in Mumbai
articles.description: Telangana seeks Maharashtra’s nod for 152m FRL height at Tummidihatti Barrage to revive the project and secure water benefits.

articles.title: Indian Railways extends 45-paise travel insurance to counter tickets
articles.description: Indian Railways extends its 45-paise travel insurance scheme to counter tickets, bringing offline bookings within the scope of the passenger insurance initiative.

articles.description: Banks in a growing economy need patient, long-term foreign capital with good governance to meet credit demand

articles.title: Expiry Date Vs Best Before: Know The Difference Before Buying Groceries
articles.description: Expiry Date vs Best Before: What is the actual difference between expiry date and best before on food packets? You must check these dates before you buy milk, biscuits, or bread. Read on to understand what these labels really mean.

articles.title: Kentucky court allows sale of land transferred for $1 to cover $177,668 debt
articles.description: A property transfer for just $1 has failed to shield a Kentucky couple’s land from a creditor seeking to recover an unpaid debt. In an October 23, 2026, opinion, the Kentucky Court of Appeals upheld an order allowing property assessed at approximately $210,000 to be sold to satisfy a judgment of $177,667.88, plus applicable costs and attorney fees.

articles.title: A Colorado family spent over 100 years raising cattle and growing crops on 10,000 acres; then 30 wind turbines added another income stream to their ranch
articles.description: The Kochis family revitalized their historic ranch, creating the Rush Creek Wind Farm while preserving their farming legacy. Featuring 30 wind turbines, this harmonious operation generates consistent revenue, all while they cultivate crops and raise livestock. With steady earnings that aren't influenced by weather or market swings, the project also boosts local economies through construction jobs and tax benefits, illustrating a shift towards renewable energy in rural American agriculture.

articles.title: Rupee's recovery faces hurdles from dollar demand, capital outflows
articles.description: Global yields, hedging shifts and capital outflows add to pressure on the currency

articles.title: Industrial growth may ease to 6% in September as capital goods, mining lose steam
articles.description: In September 2026, India's industrial production growth is anticipated to decline to 6%, down from 8% in August. Notably, capital goods production is projected to drop significantly to 2.2%, from an impressive 16.9% the previous month. Additionally, mining output is expected to contract by 8%, indicating a cooling growth trend, although vehicle sales and infrastructure goods remain robust.

articles.title: Peter Lynch on stock picking: 'You shouldn't own a stock if you can't…'
articles.description: Peter Lynchs investing advice centres on understanding a company before buying its stock. The legendary Fidelity Magellan Fund manager stresses researching business fundamentals, growth prospects and financials rather than investing based on popularity or hearsay.

articles.title: Microtek invests over Rs 400 cr to accelerate solar business growth
articles.description: Microtek has announced a significant investment over Rs 400 crore for its solar business expansion in Jaipur. The new solar panel manufacturing plant is expected to become operational by November 2026 and will support the company's energy vision. The company is also highlighting its new Battery Energy Storage System to improve energy management for households.

articles.title: Satellite lights, Google Trends can help estimate state growth: RBI report
articles.description: Combining night-time illumination and Google Trends data reduced errors in quarterly growth estimates by up to 62 per cent across three industrial states

articles.title: NCERT rolls out 20-hour AI, computational thinking module for classes 9-12
articles.description: The National Council of Educational Research and Training has introduced a module on computational thinking and artificial intelligence for students. This 20-hour course is designed for students in grades 9 to 12 with no prior AI knowledge. It emphasizes critical thinking, creativity, and responsible technology use while covering ethical AI applications. The module includes activity-based learning to enhance understanding of AI concepts, applications, and limitations.

articles.title: FPIs withdraw Rs 48,056 cr from equities in Oct so far amid elevated crude oil prices
articles.description: Foreign investors withdrew significant funds from Indian equities in October amid concerns over inflation and crude oil prices. Despite this, there were signs of moderation in selling with two days of net buying. The overall FPI outflows from equities in 2026 have reached notable levels compared to previous years. Market participants are closely monitoring upcoming macroeconomic developments including US GDP data.

articles.title: Buyer pays $1.65 million deposit luxury condo, home remains unfinished four years later
articles.description: Nilesh Undavia and other buyers are struggling to receive their deposits for unfinished luxury condos in Boca Raton. The Mandarin Oriental Residences project has faced significant construction delays, impacting buyers' financial investments. A $417.7 million foreclosure lawsuit complicates the situation for prospective homeowners seeking refunds. Penn-Florida Companies attributes delays to various challenges, including rising construction costs and supply-chain issues.

articles.title: eMudhra’s SSL/TLS exit leaves questions over weak-key lapse and security controls
articles.description: The cryptographic flaw that went undetected for around 18 months, raises questions about internal safeguards, independent verification, and the assurances that the company’s other businesses remain unaffected.

articles.title: FPIs withdraw ₹48,056 crore from equities in Oct amid elevated oil prices
articles.description: However, Foreign Portfolio Investors (FPIs) significantly moderated their selling last week and turned net buyers on two trading days, signalling some easing in selling pressure

articles.title: RBI Does Not Target Specific Rupee Level Says Governor Sanjay Malhotra
articles.description: RBI Governor Sanjay Malhotra says the central bank does not target the Rupee's value but focuses on preventing volatility and ensuring market stability amidst global economic pressures and inflation challenges.

articles.title: CBI books IL&FS Energy, executives in alleged Rs 212 crore Canara Bank loan fraud case
articles.description: The Central Bureau of Investigation has registered a case against IL&FS Energy Development Company and its executives over loan fraud. This case involves an alleged loss of Rs 212.34 crore linked to Canara Bank. The fraud stems from loans sanctioned by Syndicate Bank that were reportedly diverted from their intended projects. CBI conducted searches at multiple locations and seized various important documents related to the case.

articles.title: IAF chief outlines theatreisation vision, opposes fighter asset split
articles.description: Air Chief Marshal AP Singh has called for a phased, India-specific theatreisation plan, saying centralised control and decentralised execution should preserve air power's flexibility

articles.title: Maharashtra's Shabari Naturals earns global award for tribal-inspired packaging; PM lauds initiative
articles.description: Shabari Naturals, an initiative from Maharashtra, has received the G-Mark Global Design Award for its packaging. The packaging is inspired by traditional tribal art forms and cultural elements. Prime Minister Narendra Modi acknowledged the honor for promoting tribal products globally. Shabari Naturals aims to empower tribal communities by marketing their natural and organic products.

articles.title: Brown-Forman aims to make India a top 10 market for Scotch in five years
articles.description: Brown-Forman, known for its iconic brands such as Jack Daniel's and Woodford Reserve, sees a scale of opportunity in the Indian Scotch market

articles.title: Daily Voice: Earnings growth to stay resilient across market caps despite slow sentiment recovery, says TCG AMC chief
articles.description: Shahzad Madon of TCG Asset Management Company remains believers in the long-term AI opportunity, but the current narrative and earnings expectations appear somewhat stretched in the short to medium term.

articles.title: US Midterms 2026: Audi’s $4.2 billion bet gives Trump tariff ammo in battleground Georgia
articles.description: Trump is defending his tariff policy ahead of the US midterms, touting Volkswagen’s $4.2 billion investment in Audi’s first US plant in Georgia as a manufacturing win. The project promises 4,500 jobs, but Republican candidates face mounting voter concerns over inflation, living costs and Trump’s falling approval ratings.

articles.title: Mark Zuckerberg and Priscilla Chan said that they shifting their donations, just weeks after Meta CEO gifted state of California ...
articles.description: Mark Zuckerberg and Priscilla Chan are investing $50 million to establish STEM labs and an AI center at Sacramento State University. This generous donation aims to transform vacant state office buildings into a thriving downtown campus. California Governor Gavin Newsom emphasized this initiative will enhance the tech job talent pipeline, while the couple shifts their philanthropic efforts toward biomedical AI, aligning with Meta’s vision for innovation and education.

articles.title: Karnataka's CM DK Shivakumar OKs IAS officer's prosecution in KPSC exam paper leak case
articles.description: Karnataka's Chief Minister D K Shivakumar has approved the prosecution of IAS officer Gyanendra Kumar Gangwar. This decision relates to allegations of corruption involving the Karnataka Public Service Commission examination. Gangwar is accused of leaking exam questions to an accomplice while serving as controller of examinations. The investigation is being conducted by the CID's Special Investigation Team and the Enforcement Directorate.

articles.title: Who is Dave Doeren? NC State fires head coach in the middle of his 14th season after 3-4 start and now owes him $10.3 million
articles.description: Following a disappointing 31-28 loss against Stanford, North Carolina State University has parted ways with head coach Dave Doeren after 14 seasons. Doeren's tenure saw him become the winningest coach in the school's history with a 95-70 record. This year, NC State finds itself in a tough spot at 3-4, notably with the second-worst defense in the ACC.

articles.title: Abakkus, Carnelian, IIFL among 5 investors picking up 3% stake in SFC Environmental ahead of IPO
articles.description: SFC Environmental Technologies IPO | The wastewater treatment solutions provider will open its public issue on October 27 and close on October 29.

articles.title: Gold, Silver Prices Today, October 25: Check Latest City-Wise Rates in Delhi, Bengaluru, Mumbai and More
articles.description: Ahead of the holiday and wedding season, gold and silver prices have experienced a dramatic drop across major Indian cities. Buyers are advised to monitor local rates and understand the differences between 22-carat and 24-carat gold. Additionally, consumers should account for making charges, taxes, and hallmarking before purchasing jewellery.

articles.title: Singapore expects all parties to honour commercial gas contracts, says PM Wong after Indonesia cut exports
articles.description: Singapore’s gas importer will take the necessary steps to protect its rights and interests under such contracts, says Prime Minister Lawrence Wong.

articles.title: NICDC Launches Bihar Integrated Manufacturing City Gaya With 4200 Cr MoUs
articles.description: NICDC has launched Bihar Integrated Manufacturing City in Gaya, signing 12 MoUs worth Rs 4,200 crore. The project aims to boost industrial growth, attracting Rs 16,500 crore in total investments and creating over 1.10 lakh jobs for the region.

articles.title: Sebi plans curbs on terminal misuse, graded compliance for market intermediaries
articles.description: In a proactive move, market regulator Sebi is rolling out initiatives to curb the misuse of brokers' trading terminals and bolster compliance efforts. The focus is also on enhancing cybersecurity while safely testing AI tools. Sebi's vision encompasses streamlining regulations, promoting responsible technology, fostering deeper market engagement, and ensuring broader access for investors, particularly in underrepresented smaller towns and villages, while urging brokers to assess client risks more comprehensively.
